Name: Roshi Sprites
Author: MasterRoshiHEHE
Description:
Just a mod page where I while host whatever sprite edits I do, for others to use in whichever modding project they might have.

Currently features:

2 new Haley outfits
4 new Haley Beach outfits
Luau outfits for haley and Emily.

Will update it when I have something new.

Keep in mind these are not organized to be replacers for any sprites, they are just an archive, so you won't be able to have them in your game without setting them up as replacers first.

Most, if not all of them will hopefully be implemented in my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44489]Pixel Waifu Ripening[/url]
